Name: Novaroma Season Icons
Author: JestingDart4369
Description: 4,326 icons for your keys in five seasonal colour themes (Default, Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter), each in light, dark and burgundy: 2,163 with a tile background and 2,163 without any background (file names end in -clear, tag No background), for wallpapers and your own key backgrounds. 120 symbols for system, development, media, audio, streaming and study (new: soundboard, mixer, equalizer, waveform, headset, broadcast and more), plus 12 on/off pairs for smart-home toggles. Made with the help of AI (Claude by Anthropic) and reviewed by the author.
